notes: New: the Vault. Chats you move into it disappear from every list, search and count on this device, and stop producing notifications entirely — only your code opens them. Set a second, duress code as well and it opens a different vault that looks exactly the same, for when someone makes you unlock. A forgotten code cannot be recovered and the chats inside go with it. Putting a chat in your Vault is yours alone: the other members see nothing and are never told. Messages can now delete themselves after 30 minutes, an hour, 8 hours, a day, a week or a month. Voice notes are transcribed in the language you actually speak, read from your device, instead of asking you to choose one. Also: the back arrow is visible again on every settings screen, the layout control now says RTL and LTR, and the Terms, Privacy Policy and Accessibility Statement are published and readable in the app.
